cpu.description: CPU request and limit for llama.cpp.

deviceClass.description: DRA DeviceClass used to allocate the Vulkan device.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

memory.description: Memory request and limit for llama.cpp. The mapped GGUF file counts against this limit as reclaimable page cache, so size it above the model file to avoid thrashing.

modelCacheDir.description: Directory on the worker's own disk holding downloaded GGUF files, one per digest. It defaults to the serving recipe's cache, so a repeated run reuses whichever workload downloaded the file first; it is bounded by the worker disk (idlectl create worker --disk) and is never pruned automatically.

modelSHA256.description: SHA-256 of the GGUF model file.

modelURL.description: Credential-free HTTPS URL for the GGUF model.

namespace.description: Namespace for the ResourceClaim and Job.

prompt.default: Explain why idle compute is useful in one sentence.

timeoutSeconds.description: Job deadline including model download and inference.
